questions: If there are multiple tuples with the same maximum value at index 1, should all be highlighted or only one? If one, which one (e.g., first encountered)?
Should the legend entries be placed in a specific order or location?
Is the input guaranteed to be a non-empty list of tuples?
Are the tuples strictly 2-element, or could they have more elements? If more, how should extra elements be handled?
Should the plot axes limits be set to a specific range or auto-scaled?
What marker size, style, or edge color should be used for the scatter points?
Is the function expected to close any existing matplotlib figures or create a new one?
Should the function handle non-numeric values in tuples (e.g., strings) or assume all are numeric?
